arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One transparent Cartoon worker sprite. Image1 is the existing drawing to correct; image2 is the exact original pose authority. Repose this worker to match image2's unusual leaning silhouette precisely, rather than a normal running stride. BOTH arms reach toward IMAGE LEFT: one extends left at shoulder/chest height, the other bends then extends left at waist level. BOTH hands must be on the LEFT side of the torso. Head and torso lean substantially toward IMAGE LEFT of the hips; do not keep the rightward running lean of image1. Preserve the source's very broad lower-body stance, long legs stretching apart with the long image-right leg extending diagonally far to the right. Head orientation follows the leftward lean/reach, with one visible profile eye, eyebrow, nose and mouth. No right-side clenched running fist and no alternating opposed arm swing. Image1 is identity/material/style only, image2 rules the full pose. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two shoes. Preserve smooth dark outlined hand-drawn contours and consistent adult worker proportions. No tools, no object, no floor, no cast/contact shadow, no haze or glow. Genuine RGBA transparency. Full head, hands and both shoes enclosed by ample transparent padding.
